title: Registry manifest
description: The registry manifest pins the registry version, the registry reference date and the verification-freshness policy. The reference date makes staleness checking deterministic: a control is stale when its last verification is older than max_verification_age_days before as_of. The manifest carries no wall-clock time of its own.

as_of.description: Registry reference date. Every last_verification date must fall within the freshness policy window ending at this date.
